purpose: Test whether the causal economic decay or retirement of one structural loop family incrementally predicts which different family begins a hindsight-positive economic episode within the next three trading sessions.

opened_data_status.permitted_claim: retrospective causal mechanism attribution or justification for a frozen execution-free prospective logger

already_tested: same-pair rolling loop by current-regime profitability and adjacent-block persistence
same-pair Student-t BOCPD activation, decay, and retirement
same-pair structural breadth and coherence lead-lag attribution
same-orientation structural loop recurrence and burst continuation
current and recent regime-history movement utility
not_previously_tested: P(destination family activates soon conditional on a different source family becoming decaying or retired)
cross-pair economic rotation separated from same-pair persistence
family-to-family economic rotation with no, one, and multiple activation outcomes
a causal past-only directed economic source-to-destination transition graph
incremental M3 directed-family calibration versus identical destination-own-history population M1

hypotheses.target: M3 versus M1 paired three-session family activation prediction
hypotheses.expected_research_benefit: isolate whether other families add information beyond destination own history
hypotheses.safety_risk: future episode labels or payoffs entering graph counts
hypotheses.validation: appended-future invariance, label-availability checks, and independent graph reconstruction
hypotheses.stop_condition: reject directed rotation if paired Brier and log-loss improvements are not positive

hypotheses.expected_research_benefit: separate directed source identity from broad transition pressure
hypotheses.safety_risk: M2 and M3 populations or destination inputs differ
hypotheses.validation: paired forecast keys and feature-schema audit
hypotheses.stop_condition: retain undirected pressure only if M3 does not improve on M2

hypotheses.target: post-forecast eligible destination opportunities with frozen h24 payoff
hypotheses.expected_research_benefit: distinguish episode-label prediction from an economically available opportunity
hypotheses.safety_risk: missing opportunities are replaced by another family
hypotheses.validation: explicit family, session, and opportunity joins with no replacement
hypotheses.stop_condition: classify tradeability unknown or negative if eligible predicted-family payoff is not positive

hypotheses.expected_research_benefit: show the pipeline does not manufacture rotation
hypotheses.validation: identical forecast keys and fixed random seed
hypotheses.stop_condition: reject if nulls reproduce the directed increment

hypotheses.target: supported pair-level deviations shrunk to family predictions
hypotheses.expected_research_benefit: determine whether pair refinement deserves prospective work
hypotheses.safety_risk: selecting the best sparse historical edge
hypotheses.validation: minimum support, Holm control, and no ranked promotion

family_taxonomy.construction: all eligible parents share the frozen two-transition return-cycle topology; current frozen regime state is the orientation family

economic_state.family_state_precedence: active if any mapped pair is active; otherwise decaying if any is decaying; otherwise retired only if at least one is retired and no mapped pair is unknown; otherwise unknown
economic_state.family_probability_aggregation: retain maximum and capped-effective-sample-size-weighted mean across mapped pairs
economic_state.newly_decaying: prior family state active and current family state decaying
economic_state.newly_retired: prior family state active or decaying and current family state retired
economic_state.newly_active: prior family state not active and current family state active
economic_state.pair_payoff_support_unit: session by loop by orientation by fixed h24 horizon

activation_target.calendar: explicit sorted V2 score-session calendar within period
activation_target.episode_source: frozen V2 hindsight-positive episode diagnostics mapped to the frozen family taxonomy and unioned within family
activation_target.new_activation: family hindsight-positive union changes from inactive to active inside the future window
activation_target.target_available_rule: the full calendar window stays inside one period and at least one settled mapped-family payoff observation exists in the target window
activation_target.no_activation: explicit only when the target is available and no family onset is observed
activation_target.label_availability: after target-window settlement and, for a positive label, after the associated hindsight episode end is fully observed

directed_graph.counts: only matured cross-family target rows with label_availability strictly before forecast freeze

models.form: deterministic online ridge-logistic cause-specific multi-label hazards with destination-specific models and a past-only base-rate offset
models.M0: past-only beta-binomial destination activation base rate
models.M1: destination own causal economic state and history only
models.M2: M1 plus compact undirected system lifecycle counts
models.M3: M2 plus directed source-event graph scores
models.M4: supported pair activation probabilities shrunk to M3 family probabilities
models.M5: frozen payoff-only BOCPD destination comparator aggregated to the same family population
models.M6: frozen V1 selector destination comparator aggregated to the same family population

order: load only frozen pair-state rows created before the current session
mature target examples whose label availability is strictly before the current freeze
update destination base rates and online models
construct current destination, source, and system features
attach future targets later without modifying forecasts

economic_translation.eligible_opportunity: a frozen no-filter V2 opportunity from the predicted destination family appearing after forecast inside the registered target window
economic_translation.twice_cost_net: gross payoff minus 20 bps round trip
economic_translation.one_bar_delay: use hash-pinned sequential-veto fixed_bar_1 constant-terminal outcome where available; otherwise unavailable not zero

negative_controls.source_permutation: within period with fixed seed, target population unchanged
negative_controls.destination_label_permutation: within period after forecast generation, target availability unchanged
negative_controls.structurally_unrelated_control: source state orientation offset by four modulo eight
negative_controls.expected_null_decision: directed increment must not be reproducibly positive

requirements_for_provisional_support: M3 paired Brier improves over M1
M3 paired log loss improves over M1
period support or defensible frozen heterogeneity
null controls do not reproduce improvement
predicted-family opportunities are positive after costs
twice-cost and one-bar delay stability where available
no dominant stock edge pair or episode
exact rerun and independent audit pass
